summary.text: Kathleen James, a Democrat from Manchester, has represented Bennington-4 in the Vermont House of Representatives since 2019.
She chairs the House Committee on Energy and Digital Infrastructure.

paragraphs.text: James was born in Chicago, raised in Nebraska, and earned a bachelor's degree in political science and a master's degree in journalism from Northwestern University, according to her House biography.
She worked as a Capitol Hill reporter for Roll Call, a reporter-researcher for TIME and a senior editor for Snow Country before settling in Manchester, Vermont, in 1996.
She has since worked as a writer and editor for nonprofits including the International Skiing History Association, the BOMA Project and the Kenya Drylands Education Fund.
In 2024 she joined the Vermont Community Loan Fund as part-time project manager for its Career and Technical Education Revolving Loan Fund.
First elected in 2018, James served on the House Committee on Education during her first two terms.
In the 2023-2024 biennium she was Assistant Majority Leader and ranking member of the House Committee on General and Housing.
